constraints.name: fk_production_orders_order
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, order_id) REFERENCES orders(company_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: production_orders_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_tenant_mutation_production
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tenant_mutation_production BEFORE UPDATE ON production_orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_tenant_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_updated_at_production_orders
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_updated_at_production_orders BEFORE UPDATE ON production_orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

indexes.name: idx_production_orders_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_production_orders_status ON public.production_orders USING btree (company_id, status, deadline)

indexes.name: production_orders_order_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX production_orders_order_id_key ON public.production_orders USING btree (order_id)

indexes.name: production_orders_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX production_orders_pkey ON public.production_orders USING btree (id)
